purpose: Two separate bench-prototype PCBs; not Thin7 or a qualified product

Core-C1.copper_basis: Preserve the actual native Core stackup; four nominal 35um layers. Do not silently substitute default 0.5oz inner copper.

Display-C1.copper_basis: Explicit 1oz outer-layer fabrication selection, consistent with the KiCad export. Native Display has no explicit construction stackup.

panelization: Separate single-board jobs. No combined Core/Display panel has been qualified; single-board CPL must not be reused as panel coordinates.

impedance.policy: Preserve native copper and construction intent. The old KiCad dielectric_constraints flag is not an approved impedance order; omit the unsupported Gerber-job declaration. Fabricator stackup and any controlled-impedance targets require engineering agreement. No trace-width modification is authorized.

cam_confirmations: Core: explicitly quote nominal 1oz on BOTH inner layers; default 0.5oz is not the current CAD stackup.
Confirm the 0.8mm thickness tolerance, actual dielectric build and ENIG/green-mask selection for each board.

Core C301 now uses two1.9mm round PTHs with2.3mm lands at20mm pitch. Preserve the circular holes; do not revert to the obsolete1.8x1.4mm short slots. Verify actual part insertion/solder fill at first assembly.
Preserve separate plated/nonplated drill files, USB shell slots, fine-pitch lands and test points; do not scale or mirror copper.
WLCSP assembly, via-in-pad treatment, stencil apertures, panel rails and CPL bottom rotations require the assembly shop's acceptance.

Core requires Epoxy Filled & Capped for the exact SMT-overlap via list. Read ASSEMBLY-PROCESS.md and each board VIA-IN-PAD.csv; ordinary tenting/plugging is not the accepted substitute, and lead/slot/NPTH holes must remain open.

sources.locator: Finished inner copper; drilling/plated slots; BGA and PCB thickness tables
sources.use: Inner1oz is listed but not default. Short oval slots require specific CAM review; a zero KiCad DRC count does not approve every process.
Gerber job transfers fabrication characteristics, unlike layer geometry alone.
20+/-0.5mm pitch,1.0+/-0.1mm lead width,0.20+/-0.05mm thickness used in round-hole fit screen.

assembly_process.scope: Native SMT copper/through-via process screen; no CAD change or supplier approval.
assembly_process.required_scope: Every native via whose drilled hole overlaps an exposed SMT copper land in the generated per-board VIA-IN-PAD.csv. Full-board via fill/cap is acceptable only after CAM confirms the exact via inventory.
do_not_substitute: Open via under an SMT land
assembly_process.never_fill: Component PTH holes/slots, C301 lead holes, USB shell slots, mounting holes and NPTHs are not via-fill targets.
assembly_process.small_land_review: Preserve original lands; obtain assembly approval for WLCSP round lands 0.22/0.23mm and the listed small rectangular lands. ENIG is mandatory; paste apertures, stencil thickness and solder voiding remain unqualified.
assembly_process.coordinate_system: Unmirrored native PCB top-view millimeters. Positive Y follows KiCad board coordinates; Excellon export Y is negated. B.Cu rows must not be mirrored a second time.
